about.title: Precision CNC Machining Since 2017
about.description: eMKa Metal is a dynamically developing company operating in the metal sector. It is formed by an ambitious and experienced team of specialists who have been perfecting their skills in metallurgical processing and metal machining for over a dozen years, including the creation of precise lead details. We are not afraid of new challenges - we treat each order individually, ensuring the highest quality of execution, professional service, and timely completion. Our services are directed to companies from the construction, energy, machinery, medical, and automotive industries, as well as to individual clients. Precision and experience in every detail - eMKa Metal, Your partner in metal machining.

section1.title: 1. Data Controller
section1.content: The controller of your personal data is eMKa Metal, headquartered in Tarnowskie Góry, ul. Kazimierza Zachnika 10, 42-600 Tarnowskie Góry, Poland, Tax ID: [number], email: biuro@emkametal.pl, phone: (+48) 510325466.

section2.title: 2. Scope of Processed Data
section2.content: As part of our services, we process the following categories of personal data:
list: Data provided in contact forms and quote requests
Data contained in files uploaded by users (e.g., technical drawings, specifications)

section3.title: 3. Purposes and Legal Basis for Processing
section3.content: We process personal data for the following purposes: responding to inquiries and handling correspondence (basis: Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR - consent, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR - legitimate interest of the controller); preparing quotes and estimates for potential clients (basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR - contract performance); fulfilling contracts and providing CNC machining services (basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR); conducting business correspondence and direct marketing (basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR - legitimate interest of the controller); fulfilling legal obligations, particularly tax and accounting (basis: Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR).

section4.title: 4. Rights of Data Subjects
list: Withdraw consent at any time (without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal)
Lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority (President of the Personal Data Protection Office)

section5.title: 5. Data Retention Period
section5.content: Personal data will be stored for the period necessary to achieve the purposes for which they were collected, and then for the period required by law (e.g., tax, accounting regulations) or the limitation period for claims. Data processed based on consent will be stored until its withdrawal.

section6.title: 6. Data Recipients
section6.content: Personal data may be transferred to entities cooperating with the controller to the extent necessary to provide services, including: IT and hosting service providers, accounting and legal service providers, couriers and transport companies (to the extent necessary for delivery). All entities process data based on data processing agreements and only according to our instructions.

section7.title: 7. Contact for Data Protection Matters
section7.content: For matters concerning the processing of personal data and exercising your rights, you can contact us at: biuro@emkametal.pl or in writing to our company's registered address.

section1.title: 1. General Provisions
section1.content: These terms and conditions define the rules for providing CNC machining services by eMKa Metal, headquartered in Tarnowskie Góry, ul. Kazimierza Zachnika 10, 42-600 Tarnowskie Góry, Poland. Acceptance of the terms occurs by placing an order or quote request. The terms are available on the website www.emkametal.pl and are provided upon customer request.

section2.title: 2. Scope of Services
list: Additional services: riveting, press-fitting of studs and nuts, bending of lead sheets

section3.title: 3. Submitting Inquiries and Concluding Contracts
section3.content: Quote requests can be submitted via the contact form on the website, email, or by phone. The inquiry should include technical drawings, material specifications, required quantities, and delivery time. The price quote is valid for 30 days from the date of issue unless otherwise stated. The contract is concluded upon acceptance of the offer by the Customer and confirmation of the order by eMKa Metal.

section4.title: 4. Order Fulfillment
section4.content: Delivery times are determined individually for each order. The Customer will be informed about order readiness by email or phone. Collection of finished items takes place at the company's headquarters or via an agreed courier/transport. The Customer is obliged to collect the order within 14 days of notification of readiness.

section5.title: 5. Payment Terms
section5.content: The primary form of payment is bank transfer to the specified account. The payment term is 14 days from the invoice date unless otherwise agreed. In case of payment delay, eMKa Metal reserves the right to charge statutory interest. Fulfillment of subsequent orders may depend on settlement of previous liabilities.

section6.title: 6. Complaints and Liability
section6.content: Complaints regarding the quality of services should be reported immediately, no later than within 7 days of receipt. The complaint should include a description of the defect and photographic documentation. eMKa Metal undertakes to review complaints within 14 business days. In case of complaint acceptance, eMKa Metal will repair, replace, or refund the paid amount at its discretion.

section7.title: 7. Intellectual Property
section7.content: All technical documents, drawings, and specifications provided by the Customer remain their property. eMKa Metal undertakes to maintain confidentiality of the provided information and use it solely for order fulfillment. eMKa Metal may use photos of manufactured items for marketing purposes unless the Customer expressly objects.

section8.title: 8. Final Provisions
section8.content: For matters not regulated by these terms, the provisions of the Civil Code and other applicable Polish law provisions apply. Any disputes will be resolved by the court with jurisdiction over eMKa Metal's headquarters. eMKa Metal reserves the right to change the terms. Changes take effect 14 days after publication on the website.
